Unmodified ES module from @breezystack/lamejs 1.2.7 (dist/lamejs.js).
MP3 encoding runs in the utility worker; audio synthesis runs in the Rust WASM worklet.

Source: https://github.com/shijinyu/lamejs
Upstream: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.io/
License: LGPL-3.0; see lamejs-LICENSE.txt and LGPL-3.0.txt.

Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@breezystack/lamejs/-/lamejs-1.2.7.tgz
npm integrity: sha512-6wc7ck65ctA75Hq7FYHTtTvGnYs6msgdxiSUICQ+A01nVOWg6rqouZB8IdyteRlfpYYiFovkf67dIeOgWIUzTA==
The checked-in module is used directly, with no CDN or runtime third-party requests.
